decisions.reason: Removing the direct 'send an email' and 'call us' contact-page actions does not remove email delivery of submissions from the retained contact-request form.
The contact request remains available, so the early-access CTA can continue navigating to the contact page containing that form.
The contact-page action decision does not change the hero product visualization or its depicted product controls.
Narrowing the contact-page action options does not change the landing page's content composition or screenshot-selection policy.
The founder image and its placement are unrelated to the available contact-page actions.
The source decision does not modify the hero headline or body copy.
Removing two contact action options does not alter the landing page's visual aesthetic, brand assets, or style reference.
The dealer-login button is a separate site action and is not changed by narrowing the contact-page options.
The contact-page action decision has no effect on the Webflow hosting-plan selection rule.
